name: Reyes Manso Food Truck Medley
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js), matches the fixed location implied by the regular weekly hours.
language_source: All 5 verbatim Google reviews pulled are in English (Edgar Ferreiro, Marlon Junco, Edward, Jeniffer Gonzalez, By: Geezyboy), so English was used as the default/primary language. Full Spanish translation provided via data-es for the Miami bilingual market.
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field). curl -I on reyesmansofoodtruck.com, reyesmanso.com, reyesmansofoodtruckmedley.com all failed DNS/connect (agent-proxy connect_unreachable, no public DNS record). WebSearch 'Reyes Manso Food Truck Medley Miami instagram facebook' surfaced only directory listings (Atly, Miami & Beaches, MapQuest), no official site.

social_media.evidence: WebSearch for Instagram/Facebook handles returned no verifiable match for this exact business; only third-party directory aggregator pages (atly.com/location/ReyesMansoFoodTruck, miamiandbeaches.com food-truck listings) referenced it, none linking to a social profile.

email_search_note: No email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (no email field), no Facebook/Instagram profile to check an About/bio link, WebSearch for a Sunbiz/Florida corporation record (none surfaced). Consistent with food-truck businesses that operate phone-only.

google_business.hours: Monday-Friday 11:30 AM to 1 AM; Saturday-Sunday 6:30 PM to 1 AM (live GBP hours via gmaps_detail.js).

services.note: No prices published anywhere found (GBP, reviews). Per the adapted-variant rule, the menu cards show only verified real items with no invented prices; CTA is 'Call to order' / quote by phone.
items: Croquetas (mentioned in 8 of the pulled reviews, by far the most-cited item; served in trays with dipping sauce)

Catering trays (visually confirmed: a staff member photographed holding a large tray of croquetas, jamon serrano, mozzarella sticks and fries with Spain-flag picks, consistent with party/event catering)
Burgers (mentioned in 2 reviews; a burger is visible in one of the real table-spread photos)
Milkshakes (mentioned in 3 reviews; a branded milkshake cup photo confirms it)

reviews_verbatim.author: Edgar Ferreiro
reviews_verbatim.text: Excellent place to relax and chill with family and friends. Food tasted amazing and service was very good, staff was really attentive and caring.

reviews_verbatim.author: Marlon Junco
reviews_verbatim.text: Best food ever, this was a great experience and the food came out faster than expected

reviews_verbatim.author: Jeniffer Gonzalez
reviews_verbatim.text: El mejor food truck! The food is amazing.

gallery.note: Close-up of a croqueta tray with the Reyes Manso logo sticker and Spain flag picks. Used as hero. Real, own photo, no overlay.
Busy real customer table: burger, tater-tot-style croquetas, grilled meat, plantains, a branded milkshake, tomatoes. Used in Our Story. Real, candid, no overlay.
Large catering tray (croquetas, jamon serrano, mozzarella sticks, fries, Spain flags) held by a gloved staff member. Used in Our Story + Gallery. Real, own photo.
Wood-board platter: croquetas, jamon serrano, mozzarella pearls, olives, crinkle fries. Used as the wide gallery tile. Real, own photo, Spain flag picks matching brand.
Branded milkshake cup with the Reyes Manso logo sticker. Used in gallery. Real, own photo.

excluded_photos: 4 of the 11 GMB photos were rejected as stock/recipe-blog images not belonging to this business: a strawberry-lemonade shot watermarked theidearoom.net, a pesto-chicken recipe-blog shot, a caprese salad shot watermarked www.CrujienteyalDente.com, and a professional pulled-pork plate shot with no brand marks (no Spain flags, no RM sticker, studio lighting inconsistent with the rest of the set).
brand_vibe: Warm red/terracotta palette (#c0392b deep, #e0714f mid) derived from the Spain-flag picks and the orange/red croqueta mascot logo visible on stickers and the cup. Base: templates/light-v2 (cream background, daytime food-truck feel).
